generation.program:
(rule!
  (let* ((p8 (first (find-color g 8)))
         (p9 (first (find-color g 9)))
         (dr (- (first p9) (first p8)))
         (dc (- (second p9) (second p8))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list (find-color g 3))])
      (let ((rr (+ (first p) dr))
            (cc (+ (second p) dc)))
        (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at g rr cc) 4))
            (set-cell out rr cc 7)
            out)))))
